ownership_reason: Only the series evaluation decides how many terms are kept for a given magnitude; no other hop can restore the accuracy lost in the band 0.031 < a <= 0.087 with a one-line change (routing that band to the logarithmic formula loses about ulp(1)/a of relative accuracy, beyond the 2-ulp tolerance). asinh's series in the same class keeps four tiers for the same purpose and the class documents 0.5-ulp accuracy.
